boundaries: This is an independent read-only test observer of the pinned native producer, not a production runtime or arbitrary-state authenticity proof.
Ordinary failure requires actual complete owner bytes, pointer and length to remain equal.
The isolated allocation/history ledger rejects unsupported opcodes; four backward/Optimizer step setup events have full structural verification only.
No unknown allocation delta is filled from an observed counter difference.
The observer explicitly rejects owners larger than 128 MiB; this is not the production pool limit.
Copied mutations are not additional native executions or PyTorch APIs.
